title: Project Bundle Allowance for Installations Supplied Through Ridgeline Special Order Services
content:
When the materials of a Ridgeline Installation Services contract come through a special order of Ridgeline Special Order Services linked to that contract, the completed special order earns a project bundle allowance on the final settlement payment.

**Clause.** Project bundle allowance on the final settlement payment: when the special order linked to the contract as its materials is completed and its order total is at or above the bundle floor of 10000.00, the allowance is the bundle percentage of 2 percent of that special order's order total, rounded to the cent; when the linked special order is completed with an order total below the bundle floor, the allowance is the flat bundle allowance of 100.00; when no completed special order is linked to the contract there is no project bundle allowance.

The allowance is deducted from the final settlement payment.

## Records that decide the allowance

The special order records of Ridgeline Special Order Services: the installation contract the order is linked to, the order's status, and its order total.

| Linked special order | Order total | Project bundle allowance |
|---|---|---|
| completed | at or above 10000.00 | 2 percent of the order total, rounded to the cent |
| completed | below 10000.00 | 100.00 |
| linked but not completed (for example still ready for pickup) | any | none |
| completed, a no-charge order with an order total of 0.00 | 0.00 | none |
| none linked; materials from stock | none | none |

## Boundary and worked figures (hypothetical orders)

| Order status | Order total | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| completed | 10000.00 | 200.00 |
| completed | 9999.99 | 100.00 |
| completed | 15430.00 | 308.60 |
| cancelled | 15430.00 | none |
